templates.title: Claude Code (static MCP key)
templates.instructions: Place at the path above (or merge into your existing settings.json){{#if mcp_servers}}; the MCP servers are added with the commands below{{/if}}. Restart `claude` to pick up the changes.{{#if forward_auth}} This is a BYOK setup — only `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` is set, so Claude Code keeps using your existing Anthropic login and model selection; requests now route through the gateway (for audit and policy) and your native Anthropic models pass through unchanged.{{else}} `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` is used (not `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`) because gateway-issued tokens don't follow the `sk-ant-*` shape Anthropic's SDK validates on. `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL`, `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` and `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL` point Claude Code's `sonnet`, `opus` and `haiku` model choices at the gateway's default, plan and fast models — `opus` also serves the plan phase of `opusplan`, and `haiku` Claude Code's background tasks — so none of them reaches for a model the gateway does not serve. Optional: set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1` (Claude Code 2.1.129+) so the CLI fetches the model list from the gateway's `/v1/models` endpoint.{{/if}} Vision is auto-detected from request content — no explicit capability flag is needed. One variable in `env` turns off what Claude Code sends Anthropic beside your requests (`CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC`: telemetry, error reports, auto-updates, feedback, release notes); an admin who wants it back can edit this template.

companions.title: Claude Code · project MCP servers (.mcp.json)
companions.instructions: Claude Code reads a project's MCP servers from `.mcp.json` at the project root, and loads them without asking once you trust the folder: the project's settings enable each by name. {{#unless forward_auth}}The key is not in this file: each server reads it from `STREAMSCOPE_MCP_KEY`, which the project's settings set.{{/unless}}

companions.title: Claude Code · add the MCP servers
companions.instructions: Claude Code keeps its MCP servers for every folder in `~/.claude.json`, a file it also keeps its own state in, so they are added with its own command — run these once in a POSIX shell (on Windows, the Git Bash Claude Code runs in), and again when your servers change: each replaces a server of that name. Remove one with `claude mcp remove --scope user <name>`. {{#unless forward_auth}}The key is not in the commands: each server reads it from `STREAMSCOPE_MCP_KEY`, which `settings.json` sets — a new key reaches the servers with no re-run.{{/unless}}
companions.body:
{{#unless project_scope}}{{#each mcp_servers}}{{#unless local}}claude mcp remove --scope user {{slug}} >/dev/null 2>&1; claude mcp add-json --scope user {{slug}} '{"type":"http","url":"{{#if (and forward_auth (not ../forward_auth))}}{{fwd_prefix}}${STREAMSCOPE_MCP_KEY}/mcp/{{slug}}{{else}}{{url}}{{/if}}"{{#if headers}},"headers":{ {{#each headers}}"{{name}}":"{{#if (and (eq name "Authorization") (not (or ../forward_auth ../../forward_auth)))}}Bearer ${STREAMSCOPE_MCP_KEY}{{else}}{{value}}{{/if}}"{{#unless @last}},{{/unless}}{{/each}} }{{/if}}}'
{{/unless}}{{/each}}{{/unless}}
